picture-pairs.name: Guhuza amashusho asa
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Urukino rwo Guhuza Amashusho ku Babana n'Ingorane yo Kwibagira: Guhuza Amashusho Asa
picture-pairs.h1: Guhuza Amashusho Asa: Urukino Rutuje rwo Guhuza Amashusho
picture-pairs.description: Urukino rw'ubuntu kandi rutuje rwo guhuza amashusho ku bantu babana n'ingorane yo kwibagira. Amashusho manini aguma aboneka, nta saha ibara umwanya canke amanota, kandi muhitamwo udukaro 4 gushika 12.
picture-pairs.short: Rondera amashusho abiri asa. Amashusho arashobora kuguma agaragara.
picture-pairs.intro: Fyonda ku gishusho, hanyuma ufyonde ku gisa naco. Amashusho asanzwe aguma agaragara, kugira ntihagire ibikeneye kwibukwa. Iyo amashusho abiri ajanye, aca agira urubibi rw'inzahabu n'akamenyetso ko kwemeza.
howTo: Hitamwo igitigiri c'udukaro mukoresha. Udukaro tune ni intango nziza kandi ituje yo gutangurirako.
Fyonda ku gishusho ico ari co cose. Gica kigira urubibi rw'inzahabu.
Fyonda ku gishusho gisa naco. Ayo mashusho yompi aca agumana akamenyetso ko kwemeza.
Iyo amashusho abiri atandukanye, nta kintu kibi kiba. Fyonda kandi igihe cose mwiteguye.
Koresha « Amashusho anyegeje » gusa mu gihe mwembi muryoherwa n'uburyo busanzwe aho amashusho aba yubitse.
tips: Vugira mu ijwi ryumvikana amazina y'amashusho muriko murayaganirako: « Igikombe gitukura c'iti. Woba ushiramwo amata mu kwayi yawe? »
Reka uwo mwitaho abe ari we afyonda, naho vyotora umwanya. Ni vyiza kumwereka aho kumucondera.
Gumana udukaro tune igihe cose bikibanezereza. Kongereza udukaro ni uguhitamo, si urugero umuntu agomba gushikako.
Hezeza igihe mugifise akanyamuneza. Urukino rumwe ni igikorwa gikwiye rwose.

faq.q: Hoba hariho isaha ibara umwanya canke amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta kubara incuro wakanze, canke gutsindwa. Murashobora guhagarika umwanya uwo ari wo wose, kandi no guhagararira hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo guheza.

faq.q: Kubera iki amashusho aguma agaragara?
faq.a: Kugumiza amashusho agaragara bituma urukino ruba urwo kuraba no guhuza aho kuba urwo kwibuka. Abantu benshi basanga ibi bituje cane. Murashobora guhindura mukajya ku mashusho anyegeje mu kufyonda rimwe gusa niba mubyifuza.

faq.q: Uru rukino ni urw'ubuntu, kandi biba bikenewe kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Ego, ni urw'ubuntu, kandi nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha canke gukuraho porogarame. Rukorera muri brawuza yo kuri terefone, tabuleti canke mudasobwa.

faq.q: Twoba dushobora gukoresha amafoto yacu y'umuryango?
faq.a: Ego. Koresha Photo pairs, ibemerera guhitamo amafoto ari muri apareye yanyu. Ayo mafoto aguma muri brawuza yanyu kandi ntiyigera ashikirizwa ahandi.

find-the-same.name: Rondera irisa nayo
find-the-same.seoTitle: Rondera Ishusho Isa Nayo: Urukino Rworoheje ku Babana n'Ingorane yo Kwibagira
find-the-same.description: Ishusho imwe hejuru, abiri gushika kuri ane munsi. Fyonda ku gishusho gisa nayo. Urukino rutuje kandi rw'ubuntu ku bantu babana n'ingorane yo kwibagira, rutagira isaha yo kubara umwanya.
find-the-same.short: Raba ishusho iri hejuru uce ufyonda ku gisa nayo munsi.
find-the-same.intro: Ishusho imwe gusa iba iri hejuru kuri ecran. Munsi yayo hari amashusho abiri, atatu canke ane. Fyonda ku gisa nayo. Ni uguhitamo kumwe kworoheje ku nshuro imwe, biteza umwanya uhagije wo kuyaga.
howTo: Hitamwo amashusho abiri, atatu canke ane yo guhitamwo. Abiri niyo yoroshe cane.
Rabire hamwe ishusho iri hejuru.
Fyonda ku gishusho gisa nayo munsi. Gica kirangwaho akamenyetso ko kwemeza n'amajambo macye y'igishika.
Iyo ufyonze ku gishusho gitandukanye, urukino ruvuga gusa izina ryaco rugaca rurindira. Fata umwanya wawe.
Fyonda kuri « Ishusho ikurikira » igihe cose mwiteguye iyindi.
tips: Banza muyage kuri buri gishusho imbere yo guhitamo: amabara, uko kimeze, n'aho mushobora kugisanga.
Guhitamwo muri bibiri ntibisobanura ko « bworoshe burenze ». Intumbero ni ukugira umwanya unejeje, si ihiganwa.
Nimba gukora kuri ecran bigoye, uwo muntu arashobora kwerekana n'urutoki maze mukamufyondera.

faq.q: Hoba hariho isaha ibara umwanya canke amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta kubara incuro wakanze, canke gutsindwa. Murashobora guhagarika umwanya uwo ari wo wose, kandi no guhagararira hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo guheza.

faq.q: Haca hagenda gute iyo ufyonze ku gishusho kitari co?
faq.a: Nta kintu kidashimishije kiba. Nta nzogera irira, nta musaraba utukura canke kunyiganyiga. Urukino ruvuga gusa izina ry'ishusho yafyondwa rugaca rurindira indi nshuro mukanda.

faq.q: Uru rukino ni urw'ubuntu, kandi biba bikenewe kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Ego, ni urw'ubuntu, kandi nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha canke gukuraho porogarame. Rukorera muri brawuza yo kuri terefone, tabuleti canke mudasobwa.

shadow-match.name: Guhuza n'igitutu
shadow-match.seoTitle: Urukino rwo Guhuza n'Igitutu ku Babana n'Ingorane yo Kwibagira: Nta Kwishyura kuri Interineti
shadow-match.description: Igitutu c'umukara hejuru, amashusho abiri gushika kuri ane munsi. Fyonda ku gishusho kirema ico gitutu. Urukino rw'ubuntu kandi rutuje rwo guhuza ibitutu ku babana n'ingorane yo kwibagira, rutagira isaha.
shadow-match.short: Raba igitutu uce ufyonda ku gishusho kigize ico gitutu.
shadow-match.intro: Guhuza n'igitutu ni igikorwa gisanzwe kimenyerewe mu mpapuro zo gukorerako, ariko hano kizanwe n'amashusho manini kandi nta gucapa bikenewe. Igitutu gikeye kiri hejuru kuri ecran, hanyuma amashusho abiri, atatu canke ane akaba ari munsi. Fyonda ku gishusho kimeze nk'ico gitutu. Ibintu nk'ikinga, umutaka canke igikombe c'iti biroroshe no kubiganirako.
howTo: Hitamwo amashusho abiri, atatu canke ane yo guhitamwo. Abiri niyo yoroshe cane.
Rabire hamwe ico gitutu. Kimeze gute? Kiragutse canke kiriburungushuye?
Fyonda ku gishusho kigize igitutu. Izina ryaco rica riboneka munsi y'igitutu.
Iyo ufyonze ku gishusho gitandukanye, urukino ruvuga gusa izina ryaco rugaca rurindira. Fata umwanya wawe.
Fyonda kuri « Igitutu gikurikira » igihe cose mwiteguye ikindi.
tips: Koresha urutoki mukurikirana imbibi z'igitutu muce muganira ku kuntu kimeze.
Nimba ibitutu bibagoye uyu musi, mushobora guhindura mukaja kuri Rondera irisa nayo, aho amashusho asa neza.
Muvugane ku gishusho kimaze kuboneka: « Twarigeze kugira umutaka nk'urya. »

faq.q: Hoba hariho isaha ibara umwanya canke amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta kubara incuro wakanze, canke gutsindwa. Murashobora guhagarika umwanya uwo ari wo wose, kandi no guhagararira hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo guheza.

faq.q: Guhuza igicucu n'ishusho yaco vyoba bibereye abantu bafise indwara yo kwibagira?
faq.a: Birashobora kuba igikorwa gihumuriza kandi coroshe ku bantu bamwe, canecane mu ntangiriro. Gumenya ibishusho biroroha kuruta amajambo. Ni uburyo bwo kunezerwa no kuyaga, si ikibazo c'ikizamini, kandi ntikivura canke ngo kigobereze indwara yo kwibagira. Nimba bitera umwikomo, gerageza Kurondera ibisa canke murabire hamwe amashusho gusa.

faq.q: Hagenda gute iyo umuntu akanze ku gicapo kitari co?
faq.a: Nta kintu kibabaza kiba. Nta nzogera irira, nta musaraba utukura canke guhinda umushitsi. Urukino ruvuga izina ry'ishusho yakanzwe rukarindira ko mwongera gukanda.

faq.q: Urukino ni ubuntu, kandi mbega birakwiye ko niyandikisha?
faq.a: Ego, ni ubuntu, kandi nta konte, kwiyandikisha canke gukoporora bikenewe. Rurakora muri brawuza yo kuri terefone, itaruburete canke mudasobwa.

sort-together.name: Dutondekanye hamwe
sort-together.seoTitle: Urukino rwo Gutondekanya ku Bafise Indwara yo Kwibagira: Dutondekanye Hamwe
sort-together.h1: Dutondekanye Hamwe: Igikorwa co Gutondekanya Amashusho
sort-together.description: Kanda ku gicapo, uce ukanda ku giseke gikwiriye: mu gikoni canke mu murima, ivyamwa canke ibikoko. Igikorwa gitekereje kandi c'ubuntu co gutondekanya ku bantu bafise indwara yo kwibagira.
sort-together.short: Shira igicapo cose mu giseke caco: mu gikoni canke mu murima, n'ibindi.
sort-together.intro: Gutondekanya ni igikorwa gisanzwe kimenyerewe mu buzima bwa misi yose, nko kubika ibidandazwa canke guhuza amasogisi. Kanda ku gicapo, uce ukanda ku giseke gikwiriye. Nta kwihuta kandi nta gukosa.
howTo: Hitamo icigwa: igikoni n'umurima, ivyamwa n'ibikoko, canke muhira n'urugendo.
Kanda ku gicapo. Kica kigira urubibe rw'inzahabu.
Kanda ku giseke kigenewe. Igicapo gica cinjira muri ico giseke.
Iyo bikwiye mu kindi giseke, urukino rubibabwira buhoro rukarindira.
Iyo amashusho yose atunganijwe, rabanira hamwe mu biseke.
tips: Mu buzima busanzwe, kenshi nta nsiguro mbi ibaho. Nimba umuntu avuze ko ikintu co kuhira gikwiye kuba mu gikoni, mubaze igituma. Murashobora kwumva inkuru nziza.
Koresha amashusho mu gutangura ikiyago: «Mwararima ibiki mu murima wanyu?»
Gutondekanya ibintu bifatika, nk'amayiko n'amasuka mato canke ibifungo ku mabara, ni igikorwa ciza co gukora kure ya terefone canke mudasobwa.

faq.q: Hoba harimwo igiharura umwanya canke amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta giharura intambwe canke gutsindwa. Murashobora guhagarika igihe cose mushakiye, kandi guhagararira hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo guheza.

faq.q: Kubera iki gutondekanya?
faq.a: Abantu benshi barakunda gutondekanya kubera biboneka nk'igikorwa kigirira akamaro kandi bamenyereye. Biba kandi vyoroshe kuyaga ku mashusho uko mugenda murakina.

faq.q: Urukino ni ubuntu, kandi mbega birakwiye ko niyandikisha?
faq.a: Ego, ni ubuntu, kandi nta konte, kwiyandikisha canke gukoporora bikenewe. Rurakora muri brawuza yo kuri terefone, itaruburete canke mudasobwa.

picture-puzzle.name: Guteranya amashusho
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Guteranya Amashusho Kworoshe ku Bafise Indwara yo Kwibagira: Ibice 4 canke 9
picture-puzzle.description: Urukino rworoshe rwo guteranya amashusho ku rubuga ku bantu bafise indwara yo kwibagira: ibice binini 4 canke 9, ishusho yose iguma iboneka, kandi mukanda ku bice bibiri kugira bihindure ibibanza.
picture-puzzle.short: Kanda ku bice bibiri kugira bihindure ibibanza gushika ishusho yose yuzure.
picture-puzzle.intro: Ishusho ibereye igaburwamwo ibice binini bine canke icenda bikavangwa. Ishusho yose iguma iboneka kugira ibayobore. Kanda ku gice kimwe, uce ukanda ku kindi, bice bihindura ibibanza. Nta gukwega gukenewe.
howTo: Hitamo ishusho n'ibice 4 canke 9. Bine ni intangiriro yoroshe.
Raba ishusho yose hejuru.
Kanda ku gice, uce ukanda aho gikwiye kuja. Ivyo bice bibiri bica bihindura ibibanza.
Ibice biri mu kibanza gikwiye bironka akamenyetso gato ko kwemeza.
Iyo ishusho yuzuye, yirabire hamwe munezerwe, muce muhitamo iyindi.
tips: Gukanda ku bice bibiri kugira bihindure ibibanza biroroha cane kuruta kubikwega ku bantu benshi.
Yage ku mashusho uko agenda yegerana: «Ng'urwo rusenge rutukura.»
Urukino rwo guteranya ibiti ruboneka rw'ibice binini 12 gushika 24 ni igikorwa ciza cane ku meza.

faq.q: Hoba harimwo igiharura umwanya canke amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta giharura intambwe canke gutsindwa. Murashobora guhagarika igihe cose mushakiye, kandi guhagararira hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo guheza.

faq.q: Birasaba gukwega ibice?
faq.a: Oya. Kanda ku gice kimwe, uce ukanda ku kindi, bice bihindura ibibanza. Ivyo biroroha iyo ukuboko kudurumbata canke ku kirahuri gito.

faq.q: Urukino ni ubuntu, kandi mbega birakwiye ko niyandikisha?
faq.a: Ego, ni ubuntu, kandi nta konte, kwiyandikisha canke gukoporora bikenewe. Rurakora muri brawuza yo kuri terefone, itaruburete canke mudasobwa.

finish-the-saying.name: Heza umugani
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Heza Umugani: Urukino rw'Imigani ku Bageze mu Zabukuru
finish-the-saying.description: Imigani imenyerewe yo muri Amerika ibura ijambo rya nyuma, nk'«A penny saved is a penny ___». Kanda ku gihitamwo canke werekane iherezo, muce muyagako.
finish-the-saying.short: Mwuzuze hamwe imigani imenyerewe, muce muyagako.
finish-the-saying.intro: Imigani ya kera kenshi irazwi mu buzima bwose. Agakarata kose kerekana umugani umenyerewe ubura ijambo rya nyuma, amahitamo atatu, n'ububiko bwanditseko «Erekana iherezo». Inyuma y'iherezo, ikibazo gitekereje gituma muganira.
howTo: Somerani hamwe umugani mu ijwi ryumvikana.
Kanda ku jambo riwuheza, canke ukande «Erekana iherezo».
Ongera musome umugani wose muce muganira mukoresheje ikibazo babazanye.
Kanda «Umugani ukurikira» iyo mwiteguye.
tips: Soma buhoro kandi urindire gatoyi imbere y'ijambo rya nyuma. Kenshi abantu bararivuga imbere y'uko uruheza.
Nimba hari uwatanze irindi herezo, ribezerere. Imigani imwe n'imwe iratandukana bivanye n'umuryango canke intara.
Mu mugwi, umuntu umwe arasoma maze abandi bose bakungikanya ku kanyuma.

faq.q: Hoba harimwo igiharura umwanya canke amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta mubare w'imigendo, nta gutsindwa. Mushobora guhagarara igihe cose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo kurangiza.

faq.q: Ese twahitamo irindi jambo?
faq.a: Umukino werekana umusozo usanzwe maze ugakomeza mu biganiro. Nta manota, kandi igisubizo gitandukanye ni cyiza.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi nkeneye kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo. Ikora mu mushakisho wa interineti kuri telefone, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

word-search.name: Ishakiro ry'amagambo rifite inyuguti nini
word-search.seoTitle: Ishakiro ry'amagambo rifite inyuguti nini ku barwaye indwara yo kwibagirwa, ryo gucapa
word-search.description: Ishakiro ry'amagambo ku buntu rifite inyuguti nini ku bakuze n'abantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa. Amagambo make, inyuguti nini, asomwa uva ibumoso ujya iburyo cyangwa uva hejuru ujya hasi gusa. Mushobora gukinira kuri interineti cyangwa mukaricapa.
word-search.short: Inyuguti nini, amagambo make, asomwa uva ibumoso ujya iburyo cyangwa uva hejuru ujya hasi gusa. Mushobora no kuricapa.
word-search.intro: Ikibaho gito cy'inyuguti nini n'amagambo make gusa, yose asomwa uva ibumoso ujya iburyo cyangwa uva hejuru ujya hasi. Mukande ku nyuguti ya mbere y'ijambo, hanyuma mukande ku nyuguti yaryo ya nyuma. Mukunda impapuro? Mushobora gucapa ikibaho gishya mu kanya gato.
howTo: Muhitemo insanganyamatsiko n'ingano y'ikibaho.
Murebe urutonde rw'amagambo. Amagambo asomwa uva ibumoso ujya iburyo cyangwa uva hejuru ujya hasi.
Mukande ku nyuguti ya mbere y'ijambo, hanyuma mukande ku nyuguti yaryo ya nyuma.
Ijambo ryabonetse rirashushanywa kandi rirakurwa ku rutonde.
Mukande “Mucape iki kibazo” mukine ku mpapuro n'ikaramu cyangwa irangi.
tips: Mwereke ijambo riri ku rutonde, mureberere hamwe inyuguti yaryo ya mbere.
Ku mpapuro, ikaramu y'irangi iroroshye gufata kurusha ikaramu isanzwe.
Muganire ku magambo y'insanganyamatsiko. Amagambo y'imbuto ni uburyo bworoshye bwo kwibuka igihe mwasaruraga, mutekaga imigati cyangwa mujya ku isoko.

faq.q: Hari isaha cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta mubare w'imigendo, nta gutsindwa. Mushobora guhagarara igihe cose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo kurangiza.

faq.q: Nshobora gucapa ishakiro ry'amagambo?
faq.a: Yego. Mukande “Mucape iki kibazo” kugira ngo icapwe ikibaho kiriho ubu mu nyuguti nini, urutonde rw'amagambo ruri munsi yacyo. Buri kibazo gishya kiba gitandukanye.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi nkeneye kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo. Ikora mu mushakisho wa interineti kuri telefone, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

coloring.name: Impapuro zo gushushanya
coloring.seoTitle: Impapuro zo gushushanya ku bakuze barwaye indwara yo kwibagirwa (ku buntu)
coloring.description: Impapuro zoroheje zo gushushanya zigenewe abakuze, zifite ahantu hanini: mukande ibara, hanyuma mukande ku ishusho. Nta mwanda, nta mabara adakwiye, kandi buri rupapuro rushobora gucapwa ku buntu.
coloring.short: Mukande ibara, hanyuma mukande ahantu ku ishusho. Mushobora no gucapa impapuro.
coloring.intro: Impapuro zifite amashusho manini kandi yoroheje: ururabo mu nkono, inzu, igikombe cy'icyayi, ikinyugunyugu n'ubwato bugenda ku mazi. Mukande ibara, hanyuma mukande ahantu ku ishusho kugira ngo muyuzuze. Nta mabara adakwiye.
howTo: Muhitemo urupapuro.
Mukande ibara. Buri bara ryanditseho izina ryaryo.
Mukande ahantu ku ishusho kugira ngo muyuzuze n'iryo bara.
Mushobora guhindura igihe cyose mwongeye kuyuzuza.
Mukande “Mucape uru rupapuro” kugira ngo mubone urupapuro rwera rwo gushushanya n'ikaramu cyangwa irangi.
tips: Mubahe amabara abiri yo guhitamo aho guhabwa amabara yose, niba guhitamo bibagoye.
Ibiti by'umuyugubwe n'izuba ry'ubururu biremewe. Ni ukwishimira amabara, si ukuba impamo.
Impapuro zacapwe zikora neza n'amakaramu manini cyangwa ibiti by'irangi, byoroshye gufata.

faq.q: Hari isaha cyangwa amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta mubare w'imigendo, nta gutsindwa. Mushobora guhagarara igihe cose, kandi guhagarara hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo kurangiza.

faq.q: Ese izi mpapuro ni iz'abana cyane?
faq.a: Twashushanyije ibintu bituje kandi byoroheje aho gushushanya ibishushanyo bisekeje, kugira ngo impapuro zikwiriye abakuze. Ibice binini bituma gushushanya byoroha nta kuba ibintu by'abana.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi nkeneye kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Yego, ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo. Ikora mu mushakisho wa interineti kuri telefone, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

conversation-cards.name: Amakarita yo kuganira
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Ibibazo byo gutangiza ibiganiro ku barwaye indwara yo kwibagirwa: amakarita y'amashusho
conversation-cards.description: Amakarita y'amashusho afite ibibazo byoroheje byo gutangiza ibiganiro ku bantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa: nta kubaza ibibazo, nta gisubizo cy'ukuri. Mushobora kuyakoresha kuri ekarani cyangwa mukacapa amakarita yose.
conversation-cards.short: Amakarita y'amashusho afite ibibazo byoroheje bifunguye. Nta kubaza ibibazo.
conversation-cards.intro: Buri karita ihuza ishusho imenyerewe n'ubutumire bufunguye bwo kuganira, nk'ati “Ni ubuhe bwoko bw'ikirere ukunda?” Nta gisubizo cy'ukuri, nta kintu cyo kwibuka. Muhitemo insanganyamatsiko cyangwa mubivange byose.
howTo: Muhitemo insanganyamatsiko, cyangwa musige “Amakarita yose”.
Musome ikibazo mu ijwi riranguruye, hanyuma mureberere hamwe ishusho.
Mwumve, musangize igisubizo cyanyu, hanyuma muganire uko bishaka.
Mukande “Ikarita ikurikira” igihe mwiteguye, cyangwa mugume ku ikarita imwe igihe cyose mwifuza.
Mukande “Mucape amakarita yose” kugira ngo mubone urupapuro rw'amakarita yo gukata.
tips: Nawe subiza ikibazo. Bizasa n'ikiganiro, si ikizamini.
Kurikirana inkuru, si ukuri kw'ibintu. Niba amakuru ahinduka, nta kibazo.
Niba ikarita ikoze ku kintu cy'agahinda, mwemere icyo bumva hanyuma mwimukire buhoro ku yindi karita.

faq.q: Kuki nta bibazo bya “Mwibuka…?” bihari?
faq.a: Ibibazo bipima kwibuka bishobora gusa n'ikizamini kandi bigatera isoni. Ibitumira gufungura nka “Mumbwire ibyerekeye…” bituma umuntu wese yinjira mu kiganiro, icyo yibuka cyose.

faq.q: Nshobora gucapa amakarita?
faq.a: Yego. “Mucape amakarita yose” icapa amakarita yose mu nyuguti nini, nk'amakarita menshi ku rupapuro, yiteguye gukatwa.

faq.q: Ese ni ubuntu, kandi nkeneye kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Ego, ni ku buntu, kandi nta konte, kwiyandikisha canke gukoporora bisabwa. Bikora muri mukerarugendo yo kuri telefone, itabureti canke mudasobwa.

photo-pairs.name: Guhuza amafoto
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Gukora umukino wo guhuza uhereye ku mafoto yo mu muryango
photo-pairs.h1: Amafoto ajanye: Huza amafoto yawe bwite
photo-pairs.description: Hindura amafoto y'umuryango wawe mu mukino woroshe wo guhuza. Hitamo amafoto 2 gushika kuri 6 ari ku cuma cawe; aguma muri mukerarugendo yawe kandi ntiyigera arungikwa ahandi.
photo-pairs.short: Hitamo amafoto yawe bwite maze uyahuze. Nta kintu na kimwe kirungikwa ahandi.
photo-pairs.intro: Hitamo amafoto kuva kuri abiri gushika kuri atandatu kuri telefone, itabureti canke mudasobwa yawe, maze acike umukino wo guhuza ufise amasanamu manini kandi abumburutse neza. Ayo mafoto yerekanwa gusa kuri uru rupapuro. Ntiyarungikwa ahandi, ntiyabikwa canke ngo asangizwe abandi, kandi arazimangana igihe wugaye uru rupapuro.
howTo: Fyonda ahanditse "Hitamo amafoto" maze utore amafoto kuva kuri abiri gushika kuri atandatu.
Buri foto igaragara kabiri. Fyonda kuri imwe, uce ufyonda ku yindi isa na yo.
Kuyaga ku bijanye na buri foto uko muyibonye.
Iyo murangije, mwugare urupapuro canke mufyonde ahanditse "Kura ho amafoto". Nta kintu na kimwe kigumizwa.
tips: Hitamo amafoto agaragara neza y'ibintu bizwi bitera akanyamuneza: igitungwa co mu nzu, umurima w'amashurwe, ahantu hakunzwe, canke umusi w'ubugeni.
Amasanamu y'ahantu n'ibintu ashobora kworoherana gusumba uburanga bw'abantu, kandi birinda umutwaro wo gusaba uwo muri kumwe kwibuka amazina y'abantu.
Mureke gukoresha amafoto y'abitavye Imana nimba ashobora gutera intuntu y'igiturumbuka, kiretse gusa niba muzi neza ko amutera ituze n'ihumure.

faq.q: Hoba hari aho amafoto yanje arungikwa?
faq.a: Oya. Uru rupapuro rusoma amafoto mwahisemwo rigororotse muri mukerarugendo yanyu maze rukayerekana ku kirahuri canyu. Ntiyarungikirwa twebwe canke uwundi muntu uwo ari we wese, kandi arahita azimangana iyo mwugaye canke mukanguye uru rupapuro.

faq.q: Hoba hariho isaha ibara umwanya canke amanota?
faq.a: Oya. Nta saha, nta manota, nta kubara ingendo mukora, kandi nta gutsindwa kubaho. Murashobora guhagarara igihe cose mubishakiye, kandi no guhagararira hagati ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusozera.

faq.q: Ndashobora kubika uyu mukino kugira ngo nzowukine ubutaha?
faq.a: Ntibikunda muri mukerarugendo, ku bw'impamvu zo gukingira amabanga yanyu, kugira ngo nta kintu c'umwihariko kibikwe. Porogaramu yo ku buntu ya Golden Moments igenewe iPhone na iPad irashobora kugumiza kopi z'amafoto mwahisemwo ku cuma canyu.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo y'amasanamu
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo y'amasanamu ku bageze mu zabukuru bibagiranwa: Ishobora gucapwa
picture-bingo.description: Bingo y'amasanamu yo gucapa ku buntu igenewe amatsinda y'abageze mu zabukuru n'abafashwa kwibuka, ifise n'uwerekana amasanamu manini kuri televiziyo canke mudasobwa. Amasanamu manini ari kumwe n'amajambo, udukaru 9 canke 16, ntibisaba kumenya gusoma.
picture-bingo.short: Udukarata twa bingo y'amasanamu two gucapa n'uburyo bwo kwerekana amasanamu ku kirahuri kinini ku matsinda.
picture-bingo.players: Itsinda ry'abantu kuva kuri 2 gushika kuri 30
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo isanzwe ikoresha amasanamu mu kibanza c'ibiharuro, kugira ngo ntihagire uwugorwa no gusoma inyuguti ntoya. Capa urukurikirane rw'udukarata tudasa, hanyuma ukoreshe uburyo bwo kwerekana amasanamu manini kuri televiziyo, mudasobwa igendanwa canke itabureti.
howTo: Hitamo udukaru 9 canke 16 kuri buri gakarata n'igitigiri c'abakinyi.
Fyonda "Capa udukarata". Buri gakarata karatandukanye n'akandi.
Yugurura ahaboneka amasanamu ku kirahuri kinini. Fyonda "Isanamu ikurikira" kugira ngo mwerekane buri sanamu n'izina ryayo.
Abakinyi bapfuka isanamu ihuye n'iyo ku gakarata kabo bakoresheje igiceri, ibuto canke akamenyetso.
Umuntu wese yujuje umurongo, canke igakarata cose, arakomerwa amashi. Nta wutsindwa muri uyu mukino: mubandanye gukina gushika buri muntu yuzuze nibura umurongo umwe.
tips: Koresha ibintu binini vyo gupfukisha nk'amabuji y'amakarata canke imitiba y'amacupa. Ubuto buto bushobora kugora gutora.
Vuga izina ry'isanamu uce ugira ico uyivuzeko: "Ubwato bucira umuyaga. Ni nde yaba yarigeze kugendera mu bwato?"
Igize abantu bagorwa no kubona neza hafi y'ikirahuri, kandi mushire abafasha iruhande rw'abakinyi bakeneye ubufasha.
Udukaru cenda turakwiye cane ku matsinda menshi. Mwame mukora umukino umara hagati y'iminota 20 na 30.

faq.q: Noshobora gute gutunganya bingo y'amasanamu mu kigo c'abageze mu zabukuru?
faq.a: Capa igakarata kimwe kuri buri mukinyi, shyira ahaboneka amasanamu ku kirahuri kinini kuruta ibindi mufise, maze muhamagare amasanamu buhoro buhoro, muvuga izina rya buri yose. Mukine gushika buri muntu yuzuze nibura umurongo umwe, kugira ngo ntihagire uwusigara inyuma.

faq.q: Hoba ari ku buntu gucapa?
faq.a: Ego meza. Capa udukarata twinshi uko ubikeneye, kenshi uko ubishaka, ku bwawe bwite canke mu tsinda.

faq.q: Abantu bashobora gukina batarinze gusoma?
faq.a: Ego meza. Buri karu ni isanamu nini, ifise izina ryayo musi ku bakunda amagambo.

calm-breathing.name: Guhumeka mu mutuzo
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Akaruhuko ko guhumeka mu mutuzo ku bageze mu zabukuru n'ababafasha
calm-breathing.description: Akaruhuko katekanye ko guhumeka buhoro musangiye: uruziga rutuje ruraguka rukongera rukagabanuka mu bihe bitandatu vyo guhumeka. Murarutangiza, kandi murashobora kuruhagarika igihe cose mubishakiye.
calm-breathing.short: Uruziga rugenda buhoro rwo guhumekana na rwo. Tangiza wongere uhagarike igihe ubishakiye.
calm-breathing.intro: Rimwe na rimwe igikorwa ciza kuruta ibindi ni akaruhuko katekanye. Fyonda "Tangura", hanyuma mukwipfe umwuka igihe uruziga ruriko rwaguka, muwusohore igihe uruziga ruriko rugabanuka. Hitamo umuvuduko woroshe canke wishimira. Si umuti canke ubuvuzi, ni umwanya w'amahoro n'ituze wo gusangira gusa.
howTo: Mwicare mu buryo bworoshe kandi bubereye iruhande n'iruhande.
Hitamo umuvuduko: buhoro canke woroshe.
Fyonda "Tangura". Mukwipfe umwuka igihe uruziga rwiyongera, muwusohore igihe rugabanuka.
Rurihagarika rwonyene inyuma yo guhumeka gatandatu, canke mufyonde "Hagarika" igihe cose mubishakiye.
tips: Fatanani mu ntoke canke mushire ukuboko ku kuboko kw'uwo muri kumwe niba abyakira neza.
Ntimwigere muhata umuntu. Nimba yipfuza kuraba gusa, nta kibazo na gitoya.
Nimba hari uwufise ingorane zo guhumeka, nahumeke bisanzwe kandi arabe gusa urwo ruziga. Mubaze muganga ku kibazo cose cerekeye guhumeka.

faq.q: Hoba ubu ari uburyo bwo guhumeka bwo mu buvuzi?
faq.a: Oya. Ni akaruhuko koroshe ko guhitamo kugira ngo mutuze kandi mube kumwe. Si umuti wo gukiza amaganya canke ubundi burwayi ubwo ari bwo bwose. Vugana na muganga ku bijanye n'amagara yawe.

faq.q: Uruziga rwoba rugenda ntarutangije?
faq.a: Oya. Nta kintu kinyeganyega gushika ufyonde kuri Tangura, kandi bihagarara inyuma yo guhumeka gatandatu canke iyo ufyonze kuri Hagarara. Nimba igikoresho cawe kigenewe kugabanya ukunyeganyega, amajambo arahinduka uruziga rutiyongereye ubunini.

faq.q: Mbega ni ku buntu, kandi biransaba kwiyandikisha?
faq.a: Ego, ni ku buntu, kandi nta konte, kwiyandikisha canke gukuraho bisabwa. Bikorera muri burawuza yo kuri telefone, tablete canke orudinateri.
